messages:
maria (Sales): Hey team — customer asked for a CAIQ mapping for their POC. They want a clear split on which controls we provide evidence for vs what they need to cover. Can we clarify for Hosted vs Dedicated? @tessa (security) @devin (SE)

devin (SE): Short answer: most infra/network controls are shared; keys and tenant data ownership depend on KMS choice (BYOE vs our managed keys). I can draft a table.

maria (Sales): They specifically called out: logging retention, egress monitoring, and encryption key custody. Also want an exceptions path for any controls we can't meet during a 30‑day POC.

tessa (Security): For CAIQ, start with these high-level splits: 
- Hosted: Redwood provides processing controls, platform patching, runtime encryption in transit and at rest (managed keys). Customer handles app-level auth, tenant data classification, and integration-side logging.
- Dedicated/Private: Customer controls networking, KMS BYOE is available, we provide guidance + docs for evidence but not custody.

tessa (Security): Example evidence we can provide for the POC: 
```
- Architecture diagram (hosted vs dedicated)
- KMS / key usage logs (if managed) or integration guide for BYOE
- Access control list + RBAC screenshots (console)
- Endpoint TLS cert chain dump
- Sample audit log export (redacted)
```

maria (Sales): Perfect. Who owns assembling the above for a POC deliverable? Customer expects it this week.

jess (Solutions): I can package the arch diagram + RBAC screenshots. Need security to confirm the sample audit extract is OK to share (redacted).

tessa (Security): I can produce a redacted sample audit and a short note clarifying what we redact and why. For BYOE evidence we give a runbook not raw keys.

devin (SE): Quick callout on exceptions: we should propose a formal exceptions register for the POC scoped to non-production data and timebox the mitigation plan. Customer acceptance signature closes the loop.

maria (Sales): They asked about egress monitoring — are we able to provide network flow logs for Hosted?

sh erif (Product): typo? (this line is a correction)

sh erif (Product): (intentionally spaced name to mimic realistic slack) Hosted: we expose request logs and will provide VPC egress metadata for enterprise customers on Dedicated/Private. For public Hosted, we provide summarized egress reports; not packet captures.

devin (SE): Add to the POC scope: if they require raw VPC flow logs, mark as Dedicated or Private plus ticket for infra support.

maria (Sales): Understood. Can we enumerate the CAIQ control IDs that will need customer attestation vs Redwood evidence? Even a short list helps the buyer committee.

tessa (Security): I'll do a first pass mapping. For now high-priority split: 
- Customer attest: CCM-10 (data classification), CCM-14 (tenant access), CCM-22 (app-level auth)
- Redwood evidence: CCM-02 (network controls summary), CCM-07 (encryption in transit), CCM-19 (audit logging)

jess (Solutions): I'll start the doc with a cover note that explains POC limits and an exceptions register template.

maria (Sales): Great. One more — pricing/POC blockers: they want assurance any extra evidence work won't be charged as custom engineering during the trial. Can we confirm?

devin (SE): We usually cover up to 8 engineer-hours of POC ops & evidence packaging. Anything beyond becomes a SOW item. I'll note that in the cover email.

tessa (Security): Also add a compliance caveat: evidence we share is redacted and for POC; formal SOC/ISO deliverables require contractual commitments and time.

infra-bot: Deployment zap saw no changes — irrelevant to this thread. :robot_face:

maria (Sales): Thanks all. Next steps: 
1) tessa: drop first-pass CAIQ mapping by EOD today.
2) jess + devin: assemble arch diagram, RBAC screenshots, and sample audit by EOD tomorrow.
3) maria: I'll email the buyer with the POC exceptions register + confirmation on the 8-hour evidence allowance.

tessa (Security): Ack — starting mapping now.

devin (SE): Ack. I'm compiling the runbooks for BYOE and the note about Dedicated egress availability.

jess (Solutions): Ack. Will add the exceptions template.

maria (Sales): Closing the loop here — I'll post back with customer reply once I have it. :thumbsup:
